summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5. Verified the upstream published OpenAPI spec (viamin/color_matching#110, merged as #113, served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json) against docs/color-matching-api-contract.md, recorded all contract deltas and endpoint gaps in docs/color-matching-openapi-deltas.md, and committed permanent red-phase tests: OpenAPIDocumentTests (guards vendored document presence/content; compiles today and fails today because the document is not vendored yet) and GeneratedClientTests (exercises the swift-openapi-generator client for all six app surfaces against an in-memory stubbed ClientTransport; gated by #if canImport(OpenAPIRuntime) until the implementation run wires the dependencies/plugin). No Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container, so swift test could not be executed locally; CI (macos-latest) is the executor.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to the iOS package; OpenAPI document fetched/vendored from viamin/color_matching#110

verification.evidence: iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/OpenAPIDocumentTests.swift:30-126 guards the vendored document at iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingLPSAppCore/openapi.json (existence, OpenAPI 3, six surfaces, bearerAuth, 13 schema components, versioned schema strings). Red phase: expected assertion failure because the document is not vendored yet (Package.swift changes are deferred to the implementation run by phase rules).

acceptance_criteria.description: Generated client covers the surfaces the app uses today: manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

verification.evidence: iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/GeneratedClientTests.swift exercises getTestSheetManifest, listRecentSheets, getRankedResults, createCapture, uploadMeasurements, uploadJudgments (request method/path/wire JSON + response decoding) via a stubbed ClientTransport; iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/OpenAPIDocumentTests.swift:43-50 enumerates the six surfaces. Red phase: tests are gated behind #if canImport(OpenAPIRuntime) and fail to activate until the generated client is wired.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models

verification.evidence: Implementation-phase work (Sources/ and Package.swift are outside this tests-only phase's allowlist). The bounded plan - which models become generated types, which stay client-side, and which stay hand-written pending upstream schema fixes - is recorded in docs/color-matching-openapi-deltas.md (section 'Implementation plan (follow-up run)' and per-surface gap notes).

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)

verification.evidence: Tests are written and committed (GeneratedClientTests.swift, in-memory StubTransport implementing ClientTransport - zero network use, mirroring server-rendered payloads from upstream TestSheetJSON). Execution is blocked in this phase: no generated client exists yet and this container has no Swift toolchain, so swift test --disable-sandbox cannot run here; CI (macos-latest, .github/workflows/ci.yml) is the executor for the implementation run.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec, and endpoint gaps discovered

verification.evidence: docs/color-matching-openapi-deltas.md contains the full delta analysis verified against upstream sources (api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, router.ex, controllers, TestSheetJSON): under-declared manifest/ranked-results schemas, CaptureRequest and PairScoreRequest properties+anyOf compositions that OpenAPIKit drops (blocking gaps), stats/scoring_algorithm_version dropped from measurement schema, response bodies for uploads (200+counts vs undocumented), renamed flat-variant fields, operationIds requiring nameOverrides, and unused extra endpoints to filter out.
